why: This owner-native acceptance starts the real cotal supervise CLI, an authenticated broker, registry-pinned HTTPS authority, and a retained child from a registry-only participant root.

The release mutation proves the stock callback is the fail-closed boundary before retirement requester issuance; the commit mutation proves the third HTTPS validation is a fresh commit-time check rather than startup traffic.
